DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの改札へ向かいますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which ticket gates are you heading to?

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 在来線を降りました。ここで一度外へ出て、新幹線の改札へ入り直すつもりです。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 在来線から新幹線へ外経由で移動する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've got off a conventional train. I plan to go outside here and enter again through the Shinkansen gates.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to transfer from a conventional train to the Shinkansen via outside the gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗換えの方法は、お持ちの券によって確認が必要です。新幹線の予約と今の券を見せてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-03.translation: The transfer method needs checking against your tickets. Please show your Shinkansen reservation and current ticket.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。外へ出ると乗換えの扱いが変わるかもしれないので、まだ改札は通っていません。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券を示し未通過のまま扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. Going outside might change how the transfer is handled, so I haven't passed through the gates yet.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your tickets and check how they are handled before going through. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券の確認は係員が行います。お連れの方も同じ券ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff will check the tickets. Does your companion have the same kind?

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は別に購入しています。自分の案内をそのまま友人にも適用せず、本人の券を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者の別券にも独立した確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend bought theirs separately. Rather than apply my instructions to them unchanged, I'll have their own ticket checked.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request an independent check of your companion's separate ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの券で確認しましょう。荷物のために階段を避けたいというご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check each ticket. Would you like to avoid stairs because of luggage?

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。二人で大きな荷物があります。使える乗換え経路が分かった後、その経路の昇降設備も教えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物による階段回避を有効な経路確定後に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. We both have large luggage. Once we know a transfer route we can use, please tell us about the lifts or other facilities on that route too.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about avoiding stairs due to luggage after confirming a valid route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 券の扱いと通れる経路を先に確認し、その後で設備を案内します。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll first check the ticket handling and permitted route, then explain the facilities.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。外へ出る操作を先にせず、二人分の券と経路を係員に確認してから移動します。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人の券と経路を確認するまで改札を通らない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. We won't go outside through the gates first. We'll move after staff check both tickets and the route.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not pass the gates until both people's tickets and route are checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの係員窓口へどうぞ。改札は確認後にお通りください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHIYODA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to this staffed counter, then. Pass the gates after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの手続きについてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which procedure would you like advice about?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 転入後の保険の受付をしました。年金についても同じ紙に名前を書いたので、済んだと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保険受付で年金も完了したと思ったことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I registered for insurance after moving here. I wrote my name on the same paper for the pension too, so I think that's finished as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought insurance registration also completed your pension procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙に名前があるだけでは、年金の手続きが済んだか分かりません。受け取った案内を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: A name on the paper alone doesn't show whether the pension procedure is complete. Please show the information you received.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この控えです。保険の受付とだけ書いてあります。年金の完了まで示すものではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えの対象が保険だけだと読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This receipt. It only says insurance registration. So it doesn't show pension completion too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read back that the receipt covers insurance only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 年金について担当が状況を確認します。勤務先の制度も関係するため、現在の状況を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The pension staff will check the situation. Your employer's system also matters, so tell us your current circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい勤務先に入ったばかりです。どの制度の手続きが進んでいるかは会社にも確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新勤務先の加入状況が未確認だと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've just joined a new employer. I need to check with the company too which system's procedures are in progress.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that enrollment through your new employer has not been confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 勤務先からの案内があれば担当へ見せてください。確認できない項目を推測で記入しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you have employer information, show it to the staff. Don't fill unconfirmed items by guessing.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分からない欄は空欄のまま相談します。今日の保険の控えと勤務先の案内を別に持って説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 推測記入をせず二つの資料を分けて示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll consult with unknown fields left blank. I'll bring today's insurance receipt and employer guidance separately and explain them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not guess entries, and show the two documents separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が必要な確認先と手順を案内します。追加手続きが不要とここでは確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will explain whom to check with and the steps needed. We aren't confirming here that no extra procedure is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では年金の状況を確認し、必要な手順を聞きます。会社にも年金が全部済んだとはまだ伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 年金の状況と手順を確認するまで完了を報告しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll check the pension status and ask the necessary steps. I won't tell my company that everything for the pension is finished yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not report completion until you have checked the pension status and steps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。年金担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. I'll connect you with the pension staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご購入品についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about your purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この問題集に解答がありません。表紙には別冊付きとあるので、別に買うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別冊付きの本で解答が見つからないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This workbook has no answers. The cover says a separate booklet is included. Do I buy that separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about missing answers in a book labeled as including a separate booklet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず商品の構成と状態を確認します。お持ちの本と購入記録を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: First we'll check the product's components and condition. Could you show the book and purchase record?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本とレシートがあります。購入後に家で袋を開けましたが、解答別冊は見つかりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入品と記録を示し開封後の発見を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the book and receipt. I opened the bag at home after buying it, but couldn't find the answer booklet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the purchase and record and explain what you found after opening it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 背表紙側の差込みや包装も確認しましょう。いつの時点でなくなったかは、まだ分かりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the slot near the spine and packaging too. We don't yet know when it became missing, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。初めから欠けていたと断言はできません。包装は家に残してあるので、捨てずに確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 欠落時点は不明と認め包装を残して確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Correct. I can't say it was definitely missing from the start. The packaging is still at home, so I'll keep it and check.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the timing of the missing item is unknown and retain the packaging for checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が商品の構成と対応条件を確認します。今この場で別冊だけお渡しできるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the product components and response conditions. We may not be able to give you just the booklet here immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別冊を無料でもらえると決めず、対応を聞きたいです。買い直しは確認が終わるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無償提供を決めつけず買い直しを待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't assume I can get it free; I'd like to hear what can be done. I'll wait to buy it again until the check is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume free provision and postpone buying a replacement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入品を一度お預かりして確認してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: May we take the purchased item briefly to check it?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。本とレシートを見てください。家の包装も必要なら、確認して持参する方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本と記録の確認を依頼し包装持参の要否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please look at the book and receipt. If you also need the packaging at home, I'll ask how to check and bring it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request checking of the book and record and ask whether to bring the packaging. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当が確認します。商品の状態が分かった後に、必要な手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: The person in charge will check. Once we know the product's condition, we'll explain the necessary steps.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作業場所で気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is anything concerning you in the work area?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつもの吸い込みの音が聞こえません。木を切る機械は動くので、加工を続けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集じん音の変化と加工継続の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't hear the usual suction sound. The woodcutting machine works, so may I continue processing?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a change in dust-extraction sound and whether processing can continue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 設備の状態を確認するまで、加工は進めないでください。決められた停止と報告の手順に従います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't continue processing until the equipment is checked. Follow the established stopping and reporting procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 音が聞こえないことを報告し、手順どおり作業を止めます。集じん機の故障とまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 観察を故障断定と分け手順に従って止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll report that I can't hear the sound and stop work according to procedure. I don't know that the dust collector is actually broken.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate your observation from a definite fault diagnosis and stop according to procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで担当へ連絡します。フィルターや配管を自分で開けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll contact the responsible staff. Don't open filters or pipes yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開けません。さっきまで音があり、板を一枚加工した後に変化へ気づいたと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 設備を開けず変化に気づいた時点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't. I'll tell them there was sound until a little earlier, and I noticed the change after processing one board.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not open equipment and report when you noticed the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発生時点を記録します。周囲の作業者も同じ設備を使っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record when it happened. Are nearby workers using the same equipment too?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 隣の台も使っています。自分の台だけの問題と決めず、確認中であることを隣の担当にも知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共用設備の可能性を示し隣の担当にも知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The next workbench is too. I won't assume it's only my bench's problem; I'll tell the neighboring person it's being checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention possible shared equipment and notify the neighboring worker too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 設備担当が状態を確認します。床にある粉を空気で吹き飛ばすような作業も始めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The equipment staff will check it. Don't start blowing the dust on the floor away with compressed air either.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。設備や清掃方法を自己判断で変えず、停止した状態を引き継いで再開指示を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 設備や清掃を変更せず停止状態を引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't change equipment or cleaning methods on my own. I'll hand over the stopped condition and wait for restart instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave equipment and cleaning methods unchanged and hand over the stopped state. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのままお待ちください。担当の確認後に作業を指示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait as you are. We'll give work instructions after the responsible staff check.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品のどの点が気になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What about the product concerned you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表示は五百グラムですが、凍った袋ごと量るともっと重かったです。多すぎる商品を渡されたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 包装ごとの測定が表示より重いと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The label says five hundred grams, but the whole frozen bag weighed more. Was I given a product with too much in it?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a whole-package measurement heavier than the label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋ごとの重さには包装も入ります。表示と比べる条件を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The whole-bag weight includes packaging. Let's check the conditions for comparing with the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 肉だけの表示と袋ごとの測定を比べていました。包装を含む数字で間違いだとは言えないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 肉の表示と包装込み測定の条件差を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was comparing the meat-only label with the whole-bag measurement. So a figure including packaging doesn't establish an error.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the different conditions of a meat-only label and packaging-inclusive measurement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品と表示、量った時の状況を確認します。肉は今どのように保管していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the product, label, and measurement circumstances. How are you keeping the meat now?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家の冷凍庫です。ここへ持ち歩いて溶かす前に、相談方法を聞こうと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 冷凍保管中で持参方法を事前相談したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: In my freezer at home. I came to ask how to consult before carrying it here and letting it thaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is frozen at home and you are asking in advance how to bring it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持参の要否や方法は担当が案内します。重量を確かめるために、自己判断で解凍し直さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain whether and how to bring it. Don't thaw it yourself just to check the weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。家で包装表示の写真を撮り、使ったはかりと袋ごと量ったことも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 解凍せず表示写真とはかりの条件を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll photograph the packaging label at home and explain the scale used and that I weighed it in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not thaw it; show the label photo and weighing conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報から確認します。商品の状態や対応については担当の説明をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check using that information. Wait for the person's explanation about the product condition and response.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。重さの違いだけで返品が決まったとは考えず、保管を続けて案内された方法で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返品を決めつけず保管を続け指定方法で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't assume the weight difference alone means a return has been accepted. I'll keep storing it and consult using the method explained.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not assume a return; maintain storage and check through the instructed method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ状況を伝えます。表示の写真と購入記録の準備もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on the situation. Please prepare the label photo and purchase record too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗い終わった道具を、この台へ並べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please arrange the washed tools on this table.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 洗ったので、消毒済みの札を付けて収納棚へ戻してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗浄後に消毒済み札を付けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Since I've washed them, may I attach a disinfected tag and return them to the storage shelf?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may attach a disinfected tag after washing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 洗浄と消毒は別の工程です。今日はまず洗い終わった物を並べる担当です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Washing and disinfection are separate stages. Your role today is first to arrange the washed items.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 洗っただけで消毒済みにはできないのですね。まだ札は付けていません。洗浄後の台に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 工程を区別し未表示のまま指定台へ置く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So washing alone doesn't mean I can call them disinfected. I haven't attached tags yet. I'll put them on the post-wash table.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the stages and place the untagged items on the designated table. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。消毒の担当が次の工程を行います。昨日の札が残っている物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. The disinfection person will perform the next stage. Do any still have yesterday's tags?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一本に残っています。今日も完了したように見えるので、自分で書き換えず担当に報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 古い札の残存を報告し自己更新しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: One does. It makes it look as though today's process is finished too, so I'll report it rather than rewrite it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report a remaining old tag and do not update it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その一本は、ほかと分けて確認しましょう。薬剤も自己判断で追加しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check that one separately from the rest. Don't add chemicals on your own either.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 台の指定された場所で分けます。洗っていない物も一緒に置かれそうなので、どこへ置くか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認待ちと未洗浄の置場を区別したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll separate it at the designated place on the table. Unwashed items might be put together with them too, so I'd like to check where those should go.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to distinguish the places for items awaiting checking and unwashed items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 未洗浄は別の回収場所です。札のある一本と未洗浄を混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Unwashed items go to a separate collection point. Don't mix them with the one carrying a tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。洗浄後、札の確認待ち、未洗浄を分けて、消毒済みとは記録せず引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三つの状態を分け消毒完了とせず引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll separate washed items, the tagged item awaiting checking, and unwashed items, and hand over without recording disinfection as complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the three states and hand over without declaring disinfection complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その状態で引き継いでください。次の担当が工程と表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please hand them over that way. The next person will check the process and labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 注文履歴についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the order history?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この小さい料理が二つ分あります。子ども用の一皿は大人のセットに付いていたと思うので、重複ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小さい料理二つを付属品の重複と疑い尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two small dishes listed. I thought the child's plate came with the adult set, so isn't it duplicated?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether two small dishes are a duplicated included item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文時の内容を確認します。大人のセットに付くのは、こちらの小鉢です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check what was ordered. This small side dish is what's included in the adult set.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小鉢と子ども用の料理を同じものだと思っていました。どちらも実際に出てきたので、料理名を照合したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小鉢と子ども料理を区別し実物と履歴を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the side dish and child's meal were the same. Both actually arrived, so I'd like to compare their names with the record.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the side dish and child's meal and compare the actual dishes with the order history. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 注文履歴では、小鉢付きのセットと単品の子ども料理になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The history shows a set with a side dish and a separate child's dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二つの料理が別注文なら、勝手に一つを消してもらう話ではありませんね。単品の注文を誰が入れたか家族に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別注文を削除要求せず家族に注文者を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: If they're separate orders, this isn't a case of simply asking you to delete one. I'll ask my family who ordered the separate dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not request deletion of a separate order and check with family who ordered it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認される間、会計はお待ちします。追加の注文は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll wait to take payment while you check. Do you need any additional orders?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 追加はありません。家族に聞くと、子ども用は別に注文したそうです。履歴との違いはなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加不要と伝え家族の単品注文を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nothing more. My family says they ordered the child's meal separately. There's no discrepancy with the history now.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline additions and report your family's separate order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、現在の内容で会計してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then may we charge for the current items?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。小鉢付きのセットと単品一皿を区別して確認できたので、この内容で支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの注文を理解し現在の内容で支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've confirmed the set with its side dish and the separate plate are different, so I'll pay for these items.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand the two orders and pay for the current items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認済みの内容で会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll charge for the confirmed items.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの小皿料理をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like this small-plate dish?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三つ写っているので、三人で一皿ずつ食べるセットを一つお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真三皿を人数分セットとして注文したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The photo shows three, so one set for three of us to have one plate each, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to order the three pictured plates as a set for your group. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この写真は、選べる三種類の見本です。一つの注文で三皿届く意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This photo shows examples of three choices. It doesn't mean one order brings three plates.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三種類から一つ選ぶ商品でしたか。人数分を一つのセットで頼めると誤解しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 選択肢見本であると理解し誤解を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So this is a product where we choose one of three types. I misunderstood and thought one set would cover all of us.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that the photo shows choices and correct the misunderstanding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの種類を何皿にするか、ご相談ください。まだ注文は通していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please discuss which types and how many plates you'd like. We haven't put the order through yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三人それぞれに希望を聞きます。自分はこの種類ですが、ほかの二人も同じと決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三人の種類希望を個別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask each of the three what they prefer. I want this type, but I won't assume the other two want the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check each of the three people's preferred type individually. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 決まったら種類ごとの皿数を教えてください。取り分ける場合も人数分と注文数を分けて考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once decided, tell us the number of plates by type. Even if sharing, distinguish the number of people from the order quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 聞いてきました。二人はこの種類を一皿ずつ、もう一人は別の種類を一皿です。合計三皿になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二皿と一皿の内訳と合計を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've asked. Two people each want one plate of this type, and the third wants one of a different type. That's three plates altogether.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the breakdown of two plates and one plate and the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この種類を二皿、別の種類を一皿ですね。こちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Two plates of this type and one of the other, correct? Are these right?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、その三皿でお願いします。三人の人数だけを伝えるのでなく、種類と皿数で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 種類別皿数の復唱を確認し注文を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, those three plates, please. We'll confirm by type and plate count rather than just give the number of people.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the repeated plate counts by type and finalize the order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認した内訳で注文を通します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHIYODA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll put through the confirmed breakdown.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遅延について、どのような確認をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check about the delay?

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場へ遅れを報告します。案内に三十分遅れとあるので、私も三十分遅刻したと書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車の遅延分を自分の遅刻時間として書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll report being late to work. The information says thirty minutes late; should I write that I was thirty minutes late too?
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the train delay can be recorded as your own lateness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 列車の遅れと、職場へ着く時刻は別です。ご自身の行程を含めて確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-03.translation: The train's delay and when you'll arrive at work are separate. Check including your own itinerary.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 元々、列車から降りて移動する時間がありました。三十分の表示を自分の到着時刻へそのまま置き換えません。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列車後の移動もあり到着時刻と区別すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I also needed travel time after getting off the train originally. I won't simply replace my arrival time with the thirty-minute display.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say onward travel is involved and distinguish your arrival time from the train delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職場には、今いる場所と確認できる列車の状況を分けて伝えられます。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can tell your workplace separately where you are now and the train status you can confirm.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗換口で待っていて、まだ職場には着いていないと伝えます。到着前に遅刻時間を確定して書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: まだ職場未着だと報告し遅刻時間を確定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll say I'm waiting at the transfer entrance and haven't reached work yet. I'll avoid writing a definite lateness duration before arriving.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that you have not arrived at work and do not finalize the lateness duration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 遅延に関する案内をご希望なら、担当が利用方法を確認します。職場への提出条件は職場で聞いてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you want delay documentation, staff will check how to use it. Ask your workplace about its submission conditions.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内をもらえば自分の行程まで証明されると考えず、資料に何が記載されるかを読みたいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料が証明する範囲を自分の行程と分け確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't assume the documentation also proves my own itinerary. I'd like to read what it actually records.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check what the document proves separately from your own itinerary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が案内します。列車の表示も更新されるので、ご自身が利用する列車を引き続き確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will explain. Train displays also update, so keep checking the train you'll actually use.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。現在地と列車の情報を先に報告し、自分の実際の到着時刻は着いてから追加します。資料の提出条件も職場に聞きます。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在地と列車状況を先に報告し到着後に実時刻を追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll first report my location and train information, then add my actual arrival time after arriving. I'll ask work about document requirements too.
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report your location and train status first, then add the actual time after arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、遅延の案内方法を担当へ確認します。ご自身の報告とは分けてお使いください。
DLG-SC-TKY-CHUO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll ask staff how delay information is provided. Use it separately from your own report.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 表示について気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything about the label that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この印字を見て、店で先月開封した商品だと思いました。売っている商品は開封済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 印字を開封日と思い販売品の状態を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Seeing this printed code, I thought the store opened the product last month. Is the product being sold already opened?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you took the print as an opening date and ask about the sale product's condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その印字の意味は確認が必要です。見た数字だけで開封日とは決めず、商品を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check what that print means. Don't decide it's an opening date from the digits alone; please show the product.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。日付のように見えましたが、説明を読まず判断していました。外箱も一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数字の未確認解釈を認め外箱との照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. It looked like a date, but I judged without reading the explanation. I'd like to check it against the outer box too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge an unverified interpretation of the digits and request comparison with the outer box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が外箱と容器の表示、販売品の状態を確認します。展示のテスターとは別の商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check the outer-box and container labels and the sale item's condition. This is separate from the display tester.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: テスターを売るのだとも思っていました。この販売品とテスターを混ぜず、印字の説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 販売品とテスターを区別して印字説明を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also thought the tester was being sold. I'll distinguish this sale product from the tester and hear the print's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the sale item from the tester and listen to the explanation of the print. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない表示は製造元へ確認する場合もあります。保管や使用についての案内も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: An unclear label may need checking with the manufacturer too. Do you also need storage and usage information?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。開封後にいつまで使えるかを、この数字から自分で計算しないよう、製品の案内を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 数字から使用期限を推測せず製品の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'd like to check the product guidance rather than calculate from these digits myself how long it can be used after opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request product guidance rather than guessing the usable period from the digits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が案内できる情報を整理します。確認できない点を今日ここで断言はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will organize what information can be provided. We won't state anything unconfirmed as certain here today.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は購入を決めず、印字と使用上の案内が確認できてから検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示と使用上の情報が分かるまで購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't decide to buy today. I'll consider it once the print and usage guidance have been checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Postpone purchasing until the labeling and usage information are clear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、表示の担当に確認します。商品は未開封の状態でお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check with the labeling staff. We'll take the product in its unopened condition.
